system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

The Yamada clan have strict training regimens enforcing their clansmen to be proficient in more than just the blade. They must also be skilled in a variety of other things to help them find some semblance of balance within themselves. You can select two of the listed disciplines to gain proficiency in. You gain another discipline at 7th and 15th levels. You use your highest jutsu attack bonus or save DC for effects that call for a saving throw.

Anatomist

You gain a rank of Mastery to Survival. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a Bruised creature. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead they gain the Severed condition.

Blind Blade

While you can hear and mold chakra, You gain 10 feet of Blindsight. This increases to 15 feet at 7th level and 20 feet at 15th level. Attacks you make within your blindsight range cannot be made at disadvantage.

Carpenter

You gain a rank of Mastery to Crafting. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] to a Construct or Structure, and you use the 3rd bullet point effect of your Tameshi Itto-Ryu stance, you can roll 2 additional d6’s.

Edge Sharpening

You methodically sharpen every tool you find yourself in possession of. Over the course of a short rest, you take your Executioners Instrument and one weapon from each willing allied creature and work to sharpen or balance them. At the conclusion of your rest, the first time you roll initiative, all of your sharpened weapons come to fruition. Until the conclusion of this combat, you gain a rank of Mastery to your [Weapon Damage]. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 11th level.

Once you sharpen weapons in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete another rest.

Interrogator

You gain a rank of Mastery to Intimidation. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

When you take the Demoralize skill action, the opposing creature does not make an opposing check, but instead you make your check vs the opposing creatures Wisdom DC.

Additionally, by beating the target creatures Wisdom DC by 10 or more, if they are a Standard or Minion classed adversary, they drop their weapons, if any and must flee until the end of their next turn.

Judge

You gain a rank of Mastery on saving throws vs gaining the Charmed, Confused, Demoralized and Dazed conditions. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 11th level.

Lawyer

You gain a rank of Mastery to Investigation. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a creature with at least one rank of Confused or Dazed. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead gain the Severed condition.

Politician

You gain a rank of Mastery to Deception. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

When you take the Create Diversion skill action, you may, as part of that action, make one Weapon attack against one target creature you can reach. On a successful check, you can instead make two weapon attacks.

Surgeon

You gain a rank of Mastery to Medicine. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level. Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a creature with at least one rank of Bleed. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead they gain the Severed condition.
